name: Git Commit Message Formatter
description: Format a concise Git commit message using Conventional Commits style.
search_intent: Create or format a conventional Git commit message from a change type, scope and description.
calculation: Format deterministic Conventional Commit-style output as type(scope): description or type: description. Add ! before the colon for a breaking change. Normalize unnecessary whitespace while preserving meaningful text. Provide common types such as feat, fix, docs, style, refactor, perf, test, build, ci, chore and revert. No AI or external API is required.
limitations: The formatter does not inspect the user's Git repository.
Users remain responsible for ensuring the message accurately describes the change.
Repository-specific commit conventions may differ from Conventional Commits.
